newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS seen pressured by nine-month figures.
newsitem.headline: AMS seen pressured by nine-month figures.

text.p: Shares of chip maker Austrian Mikro Systeme were expected to come under strong pressure on Thursday after the group reported a worse-than-expected set of nine-month earnings, traders said.
Market participants expected the share, which closed at 720.9 schillings on Wednesday, to slump at least ten percent when the Vienna market opens at 0830 GMT.
"The old low of 650 schillings is once again within reach," said one. "They'll definitely go below 700."

AMS already has lost more than 20 percent over the past two weeks as investors anticipated the earnings disappointment. The share is off 63 percent from its life high of 1,967 hit in December 1995. It hit a low of 648 schillings on August 22.
The group reported a nine-month pre-tax profit of 58 million schillings on slaes of 1.44 billion schillings, battered by losses at its newly-acquired subsidiaries.
"That was worse than we thought. There'll be a lot of selling pressure today," said a trader. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
